title: Namespace scheduler ownership by canonical checkout
summary: Use one stable service identity per physical checkout and keep legacy global migration explicit.
hint_triggers: Derive scheduler service, log and task names from the canonical physical repository root and pin that root in the service environment. Route install, status, start, stop and uninstall through the same instance specification. Keep old global registrations opt-in for management and migration. Partition enabled job ownership explicitly before starting multiple schedulers, then verify two live processes and prove stopping one leaves the other executing.
